english.note: For a friendly, kindly manner, this is the all-purpose choice.
Use this when the pleasant manner is warm, kind, or welcoming, as in smiling at other people.
Use this when someone addresses or describes another person warmly and kindly, such as using an affectionate nickname.

examples.english: They warmly welcomed me into their home.
